slides.correction_move: Model /s/, students repeat three times, then recheck.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /sh/ drift and delayed retrieval.

content_payload.prompt_text: Listen and write the sound or word.

slides.teacher_cue: Say each item once, then replay once if needed.
slides.expected_response: Students write the heard sound and word accurately.
slides.correction_move: Repeat once, then segment orally if students hesitate.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can encode from sound without prompt chaining.

slides.teacher_cue: New sound today. Watch my mouth and listen.
slides.correction_move: Model /a/ with short crisp articulation and have students repeat.
slides.observation_note: Watch for vowel quality drift toward a longer sound.

slides.teacher_cue: Introduce the words orally before any print-heavy work.
slides.expected_response: Students repeat each word clearly and with meaning.
slides.correction_move: Model the word, confirm meaning, then repeat in a short oral sentence.
slides.observation_note: Watch for oral vocabulary gaps before decoding begins.

slides.teacher_cue: Say the sounds and build left to right.
slides.expected_response: Students map each phoneme to the correct grapheme.
slides.correction_move: Return to oral segmenting, then rebuild one sound at a time.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can hold the phoneme sequence in order.

slides.teacher_cue: Track left to right and read the full sentence.
slides.correction_move: Model the sentence once, then return to one-to-one tracking.
slides.observation_note: Watch for loss of accuracy at the sentence level.

content_payload.text_content: Pat sat. Pat sat at a mat.

slides.teacher_cue: Read for accuracy first, then reread for fluency.
slides.expected_response: Students read the connected text with increasing fluency.
slides.correction_move: Support line by line, then reread the full passage.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether fluency collapses after the first sentence.

slides.teacher_cue: Dictate once, replay once, then check spacing and punctuation.
slides.expected_response: Students write the full sentence accurately.
slides.correction_move: Repeat the sentence, segment by word, then rewrite.
slides.observation_note: Watch for spacing and punctuation breakdowns.

content_payload.support_text: The part at stays the same in pat and sat.

slides.teacher_cue: Say both words and notice the part that stayed the same.
slides.expected_response: Students identify at as the repeated part.
slides.correction_move: Model pat and sat, point to at in both words, then repeat.
slides.observation_note: Watch whether students can notice the repeated chunk without guessing.
